description:
Why OpenAI’s investment in brain computer interfaces raises governance questions.

OpenAI’s participation in the seed funding of Merge Labs highlights a growing convergence between AI software and neural hardware.
However, with both companies connected through the same CEO, the move raises important questions around conflicts of interest, strategic focus, and long term oversight.

As AI systems grow more capable, control over both cognition and interface becomes a powerful and sensitive position.
